definitions.explanation: A combination of multiple notes played together in music.

examples.japanese: ギターで{和音|わおん}を{弾|ひ}く。
examples.english: Play a chord on the guitar.

examples.japanese: この{和音|わおん}の{響|ひび}きが{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The sound of this chord is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {基本|きほん}の{和音|わおん}から{練習|れんしゅう}する。
examples.english: I practice starting with basic chords.

notes:
Also called コード in more casual or modern musical contexts.

Common expressions:
- {和音|わおん}を{弾|ひ}く (to play a chord)
- {三和音|さんわおん} (triad)
- {不協和音|ふきょうわおん} (dissonance)
